page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m1.xlarge is a virtual server instance categorized under the general purpose family, characterized by an atypical 1:1 vCPU-to-memory ratio. Operating on the KVM hypervisor with x86_64 architecture, this instance supplies 4 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC processor running at a frequency of 2.25 GHz. System memory totals 4.0 GB, providing an allocation of 1.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

Hardware resource provisions do not include bundled local storage, requiring the attachment of remote cloud volumes for the operating system and persistent data. The instance features a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Acceleration hardware is not present, with zero GPUs integrated into the host configuration.

Given the density of 4 dedicated AMD EPYC compute cores relative to its conservative 4.0 GB memory footprint, this instance offers a cost-effective environment for compute-driven execution that maintains low working-set memory requirements. Appropriate workloads include continuous integration build runners, stateless microservices, background job workers, lightweight web serving, and parallelized scripting tasks.

With its focus on multi-core CPU availability over large memory capacity, the server provides an efficient resource footprint for parallelized yet memory-light compute tasks. It is suitable for stateless web servers, lightweight microservices, continuous integration build jobs, and concurrent background processing workloads that do not demand extensive memory caching.
